Verra.AFOLU.VM0007.v1-8.R-1-0012.evidenceAssessment: The frozen official VM0007 v1.8 PDF (source PDF SHA-256: 68bb94746c4c4adb40acbe314a3f927e2a3a57af9bf4916afdbcf532ea0b50e6) places condition R-1-0012 in Section 4.3.3 CIW Project Activities, condition 17, under 4.3 WRC. Maya project evidence establishes REDD/APDef classification, no peatlands or tidal wetlands, and no WRC modules. The methodology structure separates REDD applicability (Section 4.2) from WRC applicability (Section 4.3). Sufficient to conclude this WRC-specific condition does not apply.

finalRuleDecision.assessmentReason: Official VM0007 v1.8 PDF Section 4.3.3 CIW places the tidal wetland conservation condition under the WRC branch. Maya project is REDD/APDef with no peatlands or tidal wetlands. Condition does not apply to REDD-only projects.
finalRuleDecision.correctionReason: Previously PROVISIONAL. Official PDF confirms WRC-only scope. No WRC components in Maya project. Resolved NOT_APPLICABLE.

Verra.AFOLU.VM0007.v1-8.R-1-0013.evidenceAssessment: Official VM0007 v1.8 PDF places the wetland degradation agent condition under the WRC branch (Section 4.3). Maya project evidence confirms: (1) VM0007 REDD+ Methodology Framework, (2) VMD0006 (BL-PL) module for planned deforestation, (3) no peatlands or tidal wetlands, (4) baseline deforestation is planned deforestation, (5) REDD module is mandatory. Condition R-1-0013 belongs within the WRC/CIW branch, structurally separate from the REDD branch. Not applicable to the REDD/APDef project.
